mandatory_peers.description: Deprecated alias for class_floors.HARNESS. Kept for one-release grace period.

class_floors.description: Per-class mandatory peer role-lists. Keys are wave class names (HARNESS, DOC, FAST-PATH). Values are arrays of peer role names that must be present in the session team.

default_class.description: Default wave class when CLASS sentinel is absent. Fail-safe: HARNESS.

sentinel_dir.description: Directory (relative to project root) where wave quality-gate sentinels are stored. Default: .claude/wave-quality-gates

sentinel_filename_template.description: Filename template for quality-gate sentinels. {slug} is replaced with the wave slug. Default: {slug}.md
